item.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

item.title: אדם שתקף את הנזירה בטלוויזיה במעגל סגור בירושלים זוכה מטעמי בריאות נפשית
item.description: בית משפט בירושלים אמר כי התוקף היהודי עבר אפיזודה פסיכוטית כאשר תקף את הנזירה, בתקרית שגרמה לזעם.

item.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
item.description: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.

item.title: Two-year curfew lifted in Sudan's capital
item.description: The military authorities retook control of the city 18 months ago, but the conflict continues elsewhere.

item.title: Dutch court sentences man to life over Rwanda genocide
item.description: The court in The Hague convicted the 66-year-old of war crimes and the crime of genocide.

item.title: Fed has 'work to do' if price rises don't ease for Americans, Warsh says
item.description: Kevin Warsh remarks suggest interest rates could be increased if policymakers think inflation is running too high.
